lines.en: I drag my body forward.
I make a long sound.
Something in the mist keeps pace.
My body is very thin.
My ankles pale in the mist.
I do not know why I am crying.
I head toward where people are.
My hands hang light at my sides.
My voice spreads through the mist.
I drag my feet around the rubble.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，声音却拖得很长
lines.en: I walk slowly, but the sound trails long.

lines.zh: 灰白的影子在路上移动
lines.en: A pale shadow moves on the road.
I stand and the sound does not stop.
I look up; there is no light in my eyes.

lines.zh: 风把我的声音带走一点
lines.en: The wind carries a little of my voice off.
I am listening to myself weep.
The rags on me stir.
I want to stop, and cannot.
The mist circles around me.
I reach out and pull my hand back.
There are tear marks on the ground.
I do not remember who is waiting.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张开，就合不上了。
lines.en: My mouth hangs open and won't close.
I come toward you, very slowly.

lines.zh: 我想说点什么，只有声音出来
lines.en: I want to say something; only sound comes.
Do not fear; I will not move suddenly.
My wail arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 你看起来很像一个我记得的人
lines.en: You look like someone I remember.
I reach out, but do not touch.
Can you understand me?

lines.zh: 我的声音让你不舒服吗
lines.en: Does my voice trouble you?
A little mist lies between us.

lines.zh: 哭声卡在喉咙，变成嘶声。
lines.en: My wail catches and turns to a hiss.
I step back, and the mist with me.
A piece of my body is missing.
I gather, and fray a little.

lines.zh: 这一下让我想起自己还在这里
lines.en: That reminded me I am still here.
I did not cry out.
My shadow shivers on the stone.
The mist has thickened.
I can still walk.
Do not let me scatter.

lines.zh: 那个味道让我停了一下
lines.en: That smell made me pause.
I come closer slowly.
My voice has grown quieter.
What you hold is warm.
My empty palm opens.

lines.zh: 我已经很久没有拿到过东西
lines.en: I have not held anything in a long time.

lines.zh: 这东西有点像我以前的
lines.en: This looks a little like something of mine.
May I take it?
It shines in your hand.

lines.zh: 我伸手够了够你的口袋。
lines.en: I reach for your pocket.
You struck me; I am light as mist.
I swayed once.
This body of mine is not solid.

lines.zh: 你退开时带走了我的一部分
lines.en: You carried part of me away.
I gather myself back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我安静了一瞬
lines.en: That quieted me for an instant.

lines.zh: 我的手指碰到你的袖子。
lines.en: My fingers touch your sleeve.
Do not push me with your hands.
I come apart at a touch.
My wailing drifts through the fog.

lines.zh: 很久没有人愿意靠近我了
lines.en: No one has wanted to come near me for a long time.

lines.zh: 我站在你旁边，声音小一点
lines.en: Beside you, my voice is smaller.
You may listen to me weep a while.
I will not touch you.
This body is cold.
The mist will hide us.
I will know when you leave.

lines.zh: 我把额头抵在你的背上。
lines.en: I press my brow to your back.
I will keep to this corner.
The sound will always be here.
I cup it like a small bird.
My hands are trembling a little.
It carries a little warmth.
I have not felt warmth in ages.
I press it to my chest.

lines.zh: 十七点生命，怨声比身体大。
lines.en: Seventeen health; my wail outgrows my body.
But I keep it anyway.

lines.zh: 它让我的声音小了一点
lines.en: It has made my voice quieter.
Thank you very much indeed.
I will remember this.

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步停下来了
lines.en: I heard your steps stop.
I turn toward you.
My voice has changed pitch.
Do not just leave.
I want to be nearer to you.
My fingers have spread.
This is not out of malice.

lines.zh: 只是我太久没有碰到活人
lines.en: I have simply not touched the living in too long.
Step back, and I will stop.
I will go as slowly as I can.
Do not cry out.
Shouting makes it worse for me.

lines.zh: 哭声从喉咙里自己冒出来。
lines.en: The wailing comes out of my throat on its own.
Please wait for me a moment.
Only a little while.
I will draw my hand back.
I follow behind you.
Your footsteps are clear.

lines.zh: 我的哭声贴着你的后颈。
lines.en: My wail clings to your neck.

lines.zh: 我没有加速，也没有减慢
lines.en: I neither speed up nor slow down.
My weeping is on the left.
You look back; no one is there.
I am on your right.
The mist makes me seem farther.
I am actually very close.
My voice covers my steps.

lines.zh: 你已经开始习惯这个声音了
lines.en: You are growing used to the sound.
My wailing is finally close.
Then I stop too.
My tears fall on the flagstones.
Until you turn around.
I will not hurry you.
I have all the time there is.
I lean on the wall and weep softly.
You truly need not fear me.
I only want to hear you speak.
I reach out and touch you.
This is too light to be an attack.
There is a little warmth on you.
I withdraw; my hand is cold.
My voice has grown sharp.

lines.zh: 你退开时我抓住了衣袖
lines.en: I caught your sleeve as you pulled away.
I did not want this.
I have come a little closer.

lines.zh: 这一次我碰到了你的手
lines.en: This time I touched your hand.
Your hand is so warm.
I let my hand down.
I am truly sorry.
I retreat into the mist.
The sound still lingers.
I hold on and will not let go.

lines.zh: 我攥住你的手腕，往暗里拖。
lines.en: I grip your wrist and drag you into the dark.
You are trembling.

lines.zh: 我的指甲刮过你的手臂。
lines.en: My nails rake your arm.
My weeping is right at your ear.

lines.zh: 这一次我碰到了你的肩
lines.en: This time I touched your shoulder.
Weeping starts in the mist.
I show myself out of the mist.
A pale figure, very thin.
I take two steps this way.
My voice arrived before I did.
Tear marks remain on the ground.
I step half out of the mist.
It is quiet here, except for me.
I slowly make out my surroundings.

lines.zh: 我记得这里有一点熟悉
lines.en: This place feels faintly familiar.
The wailing leads me on.
Better not be alone.
Fire burned my rags.
I fell, and half of me scattered.
Water presses me silent.

lines.zh: 冲击把雾连同我一起冲散
lines.en: The blast scatters the mist and me.
It passed through me.

lines.zh: 那道力量让我定住不能动
lines.en: That force pins me in place.
I am so hungry I cannot recall.
Lightning lights me up; it hurts.
There is not even mist here.
